import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(14, 6.0), dpi=300)
ax.set_xlim(0, 14)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 6.0)
ax.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Palette
navy      = '#1B2838'
navy_mid  = '#2C3E50'
blue      = '#2E78B7'
blue_lt   = '#EAF2FA'
blue_med  = '#B5D0E8'
amber     = '#D4822A'
amber_lt  = '#FFF6EC'
amber_bdr = '#C47520'
green     = '#27AE60'
green_lt  = '#E8F8EE'
red_soft  = '#E74C3C'
gray_t    = '#6B7B8D'
gray_l    = '#9EAAB6'
gray_bg   = '#F4F6F8'
gray_bdr  = '#CDD5DC'
dark      = '#1A1A2E'
purple    = '#8E44AD'
purple_lt = '#F3E8F9'

def rbox(x,y,w,h,fc,ec,lw=1.5,zo=2,ls='solid'):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                       facecolor=fc,edgecolor=ec,linewidth=lw,linestyle=ls,zorder=zo)
    ax.add_patch(b)

def sbox(x,y,w,h,fc,ec,lw=1.5,zo=2):
    # with shadow
    for dx,dy,a in [(0.04,-0.04,'#00000007'),(0.02,-0.02,'#00000005')]:
        s = FancyBboxPatch((x+dx,y+dy),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                           facecolor=a,edgecolor='none',linewidth=0,zorder=zo-1)
        ax.add_patch(s)
    rbox(x,y,w,h,fc,ec,lw,zo)

def arr(x1,y1,x2,y2,c='#78909C',lw=1.3,zo=8,style='->'):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),
                        arrowstyle=f'{style},head_length=5,head_width=3',
                        color=c,linewidth=lw,zorder=zo)
    ax.add_patch(a)

def carrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,c='#78909C',lw=1.0,rad=0.3,zo=8,ls='solid',style='->'):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),
                        arrowstyle=f'{style},head_length=4,head_width=2.5',
                        color=c,linewidth=lw,
                        connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                        linestyle=ls,zorder=zo)
    ax.add_patch(a)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION A: LEFT — One Transformer Layer (detailed)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Large container: "Layer ℓ"
sbox(0.1, 0.7, 5.9, 5.0, '#FAFBFC', '#B8C4D0', 1.2, zo=1)
ax.text(0.3, 5.50, r'Layer $\ell$  (×32)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        ha='left', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=gray_t, zorder=5)

# --- Hidden state h ---
sbox(0.35, 4.35, 1.15, 0.55, gray_bg, gray_bdr, 1.0, zo=3)
ax.text(0.92, 4.62, r'$\mathbf{h}^{(\ell)}$', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=dark, zorder=5)
ax.text(0.92, 4.42, 'hidden', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=gray_t, zorder=5)

# --- Predictor f_θ ---
sbox(2.1, 4.1, 2.0, 1.05, blue_lt, blue, 1.5, zo=3)
ax.text(3.1, 4.90, r'Predictor $f_\theta$', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=blue, zorder=5)
# Architecture detail inside
ax.text(3.1, 4.55, r'$\mathbf{h} \!\to\! \mathrm{Linear}_{4096 \to 128}$', fontsize=7.5,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#3A5A7B', zorder=5)
ax.text(3.1, 4.30, r'$\to\! \mathrm{GELU} \!\to\! \mathrm{Linear}_{128 \to 14336}$', fontsize=7.5,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#3A5A7B', zorder=5)

# Arrow h → predictor
arr(1.50, 4.62, 2.1, 4.62, c=gray_l, lw=1.2)

# --- Gumbel-Sigmoid ---
sbox(2.1, 3.0, 2.0, 0.72, purple_lt, purple, 1.2, zo=3)
ax.text(3.1, 3.55, r'Gumbel-$\sigma(\tau)$', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=purple, zorder=5)
ax.text(3.1, 3.22, r'$\tilde{m}_j = \sigma_\tau(s_j + \varepsilon)$', fontsize=8,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#6A3A8A', zorder=5)

# Arrow predictor → Gumbel (scores s)
arr(3.1, 4.1, 3.1, 3.72, c=blue, lw=1.2)
ax.text(3.45, 3.93, r'$\mathbf{s}$', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=blue, zorder=5)

# --- Soft mask output ---
sbox(2.35, 2.05, 1.5, 0.55, green_lt, green, 1.2, zo=3)
ax.text(3.1, 2.32, r'$\tilde{\mathbf{m}}^{(\ell)}$', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=green, zorder=5)
ax.text(3.1, 2.12, 'soft mask', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color='#1D7A40', zorder=5)

# Arrow Gumbel → mask
arr(3.1, 3.0, 3.1, 2.60, c=purple, lw=1.2)

# --- SwiGLU FFN ---
sbox(0.35, 0.95, 3.2, 0.8, '#FFF8F0', amber_bdr, 1.5, zo=3)
ax.text(1.95, 1.55, 'SwiGLU FFN', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=amber, zorder=5)
ax.text(1.95, 1.22, r'$(\sigma(\mathbf{h} W_g) \odot \mathbf{h} W_u) \odot \tilde{\mathbf{m}} \cdot W_d$',
        fontsize=8, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#8A5A1A', zorder=5)
ax.text(1.95, 1.02, r'mask zeros out pruned neurons', fontsize=6.5,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', color=gray_t,
        style='italic', zorder=5)

# Arrow h → FFN (downward on left side)
carrow(0.92, 4.35, 0.92, 1.75, c=gray_l, lw=1.0, rad=0, zo=6)

# Arrow mask → FFN (mask applied)
arr(3.1, 2.05, 2.6, 1.75, c=green, lw=1.2)

# --- Output h' ---
sbox(4.15, 0.95, 1.15, 0.55, gray_bg, gray_bdr, 1.0, zo=3)
ax.text(4.72, 1.22, r"$\mathbf{h}'^{(\ell)}$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=dark, zorder=5)

# Arrow FFN → output
arr(3.55, 1.35, 4.15, 1.22, c=amber_bdr, lw=1.2)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION B: RIGHT — Training Pipeline (output distribution)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# --- Dense model (compact, frozen) ---
sbox(6.6, 4.35, 2.5, 1.2, '#F0F2F5', navy_mid, 1.8, zo=3)
ax.text(7.85, 5.15, 'Dense LLM', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=navy, zorder=5)

# Frozen badge
fb = FancyBboxPatch((7.15, 4.55), 1.4, 0.30, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                     facecolor='#E0E6ED', edgecolor='#B0B8C5', linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
ax.add_patch(fb)
ax.text(7.85, 4.70, 'frozen · no masks', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=gray_t, style='italic', zorder=5)

# --- Sparse model (uses predictors) ---
sbox(6.6, 2.4, 2.5, 1.5, blue_lt, blue, 1.8, zo=3)
ax.text(7.85, 3.55, 'Sparse LLM', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=blue, zorder=5)
ax.text(7.85, 3.18, 'with predictors', fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color='#3A6A9A', style='italic', zorder=5)

# Mini mask visualization inside
np.random.seed(42)
mask = np.random.random((3,10)) > 0.35
for r in range(3):
    for c in range(10):
        color = blue if mask[r,c] else '#D8E8F5'
        rect = Rectangle((6.85+c*0.16, 2.58+r*0.16), 0.14, 0.14,
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7, zorder=4)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
ax.text(8.55, 2.82, r'$\tilde{\mathbf{m}}$', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=blue, zorder=5)

# Arrow from layer detail to Sparse model
carrow(5.30, 1.22, 6.6, 3.0, c=gray_l, lw=1.0, rad=-0.2, zo=6)
ax.text(5.8, 1.85, r'$\times$32', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=gray_t,
        rotation=50, zorder=7)

# --- p_dense pill ---
sbox(9.7, 4.7, 1.2, 0.50, navy, navy, 0, zo=5)
ax.text(10.3, 4.95, r'$p_{\mathrm{dense}}$', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', color='white', zorder=6)

# --- p_sparse pill ---
sbox(9.7, 2.95, 1.2, 0.50, blue, blue, 0, zo=5)
ax.text(10.3, 3.20, r'$p_{\mathrm{sparse}}$', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', color='white', zorder=6)

# Arrows: Dense → p_dense, Sparse → p_sparse
arr(9.1, 4.95, 9.7, 4.95, c=navy_mid, lw=1.3)
arr(9.1, 3.15, 9.7, 3.20, c=blue, lw=1.3)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION C: KL Loss
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sbox(11.3, 2.7, 2.4, 3.0, amber_lt, amber_bdr, 2.2, zo=3)

# Distribution curves
t = np.linspace(0,2.5,100)
d1 = np.exp(-(t-1.0)**2/0.22)*0.22
d2 = np.exp(-(t-1.25)**2/0.30)*0.18
cx0 = 11.55; cy0 = 3.0; sx = 0.85; sy = 2.5
ax.fill_between(cx0+t*sx, cy0, cy0+d1*sy, color=navy, alpha=0.12, zorder=4)
ax.plot(cx0+t*sx, cy0+d1*sy, color=navy, lw=1.2, alpha=0.5, zorder=4)
ax.fill_between(cx0+t*sx, cy0, cy0+d2*sy, color=blue, alpha=0.08, zorder=4)
ax.plot(cx0+t*sx, cy0+d2*sy, color=blue, lw=1.2, alpha=0.5, ls='--', zorder=4)

# Shaded area between (KL divergence visual)
ax.fill_between(cx0+t*sx, cy0+d2*sy, cy0+d1*sy,
                where=d1>d2, color=amber, alpha=0.08, zorder=4)

# Formula
ax.text(12.5, 5.3, r'$D_{\mathrm{KL}}$', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color=dark, zorder=6)
ax.text(12.5, 4.95, r'$p_{\mathrm{dense}} \| p_{\mathrm{sparse}}$', fontsize=11,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#5A4A3A', zorder=6)

# "gradients to θ only" badge
gb = FancyBboxPatch((11.55, 4.35), 1.9, 0.32, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                     facecolor='#FFEDCC', edgecolor='#E0C080', linewidth=0.5, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(gb)
ax.text(12.5, 4.51, r'$\nabla_\theta$ only', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif', color='#7A5A10', zorder=6)

# Arrows: p_dense → KL, p_sparse → KL
arr(10.9, 4.85, 11.3, 4.5, c=navy_mid, lw=1.4)
arr(10.9, 3.30, 11.3, 3.5, c=blue, lw=1.4)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKPROP ARROW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KL → predictor (dashed, curves below)
bp = FancyArrowPatch((12.5, 2.7), (3.1, 4.1),
                     arrowstyle='->,head_length=5,head_width=3',
                     color='#E74C3C', linewidth=1.2,
                     connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.5',
                     linestyle=(0,(5,4)), zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(bp)
ax.text(8.5, 1.22, r'$\nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KL}}$', fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='serif', color='#E74C3C', zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#E74C3C',
                  linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.9))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BOTTOM BAR: Training vs Inference
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax.plot([0.1, 13.9], [-0.1, -0.1], color='#D0D8E0', lw=0.7, linestyle=':', zorder=1)

tb = FancyBboxPatch((0.5, -0.42), 5.2, 0.35, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                     facecolor='#F5F7FA', edgecolor='#D0D8E0', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(tb)
ax.text(3.1, -0.245, r'Training:  soft masks $\tilde{\mathbf{m}}$ via Gumbel-$\sigma(\tau)$',
        fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif',
        color='#3A4A5C', fontweight='bold', zorder=4)

ib = FancyBboxPatch((7.8, -0.42), 5.8, 0.35, boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                     facecolor='#F5F7FA', edgecolor='#D0D8E0', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(ib)
ax.text(10.7, -0.245, r'Inference:  hard masks $\mathbf{m}$ via TEAL global top-$k$',
        fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif',
        color='#3A4A5C', fontweight='bold', zorder=4)

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_14/projects/distill_sparse_swiglu/figures/paper/fig1_overview'
plt.savefig(f'{out}.png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.08, dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.savefig(f'{out}.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.08, dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print('Done - v12')
